panels.description: Prompt (prefill) token length distribution: P99/P95/P50 and average, computed from the prompt_tokens_histogram. Note: this metric is recorded without a model_name label on some builds; the $model_name filter is applied where the label exists.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

panels.title: SGLang: Prompt Token Length

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

panels.title: SGLang: Generation Token Length

panels.description: Time To First Token (TTFT) latency: P99/P95/P50 and average, from the time_to_first_token_seconds histogram. Measures prefill + queue time before the first decoded token.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

panels.title: SGLang: Time To First Token (TTFT)

panels.description: Time Per Output Token (TPOT), approximated by the inter_token_latency_seconds histogram (latency between successive generated tokens): P99/P95/P50 and average.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

panels.title: SGLang: Time Per Output Token (TPOT)

panels.description: Heatmap of Time To First Token (TTFT), from the time_to_first_token_seconds histogram. Each cell is the request count in a latency bucket over the interval. Labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).
panels.title: SGLang: Time To First Token (TTFT) Heatmap

panels.description: Heatmap of inter-token latency (TPOT proxy), from the inter_token_latency_seconds histogram. Each cell is the token count in a latency bucket over the interval. Labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).
panels.title: SGLang: Time Per Output Token (TPOT) Heatmap

panels.description: Heatmap of request prompt length, from the prompt_tokens_histogram. Each cell is the request count in a length bucket over the interval. Note: this histogram is labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).
panels.title: SGLang: Request Prompt Length

panels.description: Heatmap of request generation length, from the generation_tokens_histogram. Each cell is the request count in a length bucket over the interval. Note: this histogram is labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).
panels.title: SGLang: Request Generation Length

panels.description: KV cache eviction rate: tokens evicted from the GPU KV cache per second (radix cache pressure). Sustained non-zero values indicate the KV cache is full and tokens are being reclaimed. Note: evicted_tokens_total is labeled by cache_type only (no model_name), so the $model_name filter does not apply here.
panels.title: SGLang: KV Cache Eviction Rate

panels.description: Time spent evicting KV cache memory from GPU to CPU, from the eviction_duration_seconds histogram: P99/P95/P50 and average. Labeled by cache_type only (no model_name).

targets.expr: sum by(cache_type, job) (rate(sglang:eviction_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(cache_type, job) (rate(sglang:eviction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

panels.title: SGLang: KV Cache Eviction Duration
